architecture.editorial_thesis: W42 was not a simple model-release week. Frontier agent execution (Wonder, Argon), hyperscaler silicon and active-compute economics (Maia 300, LFM2.5), licensing constraints on open-weight deployment (Muse terms, Apache 2.0, OpenMDW-1.1, Kommunity output-only), software-engineering orchestration (Codex practice, Scion, HydraFusion plus delivery gates), operational safety boundaries (disclosed incidents, distillation defenses, ECDSA closure, evaluator access), and scientific agency (closed-loop wet-lab, geospatial reasoning, review infrastructure) advanced together. The issue reports which system capability is real and what remains merely a vendor claim, keeping usable numbers with denominators and license conditions visible.
